motion.name: state-shift
motion.purpose: Buttons, cards, and tabs respond quickly without spectacle.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main conversion action on a dark or light surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background:#355CFF; color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:6px; padding:12px 32px; font:600 14px Manrope,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 200ms ease,background 200ms ease; }.ds-button-primary:hover { background:#2548D8; transform:translateY(-2px); }.ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #91A4FF; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: A calm, technical and specific system for a compact professional practice. Ink establishes conviction, paper supports reading, and graphite signals decisions.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Graphite is reserved for a visitor decision, an active state, or a meaningful link.

dos: Do let real project imagery and case-study detail provide proof.
Do preserve bilingual content, theme switching, and existing navigation paths.
donts: Don't use graphite as a decorative accent across every surface.
Don't introduce glassmorphism, neon glow, dashboard metrics, or generic agency imagery.
